Role Overview: The Plant Head will lead the full spectrum of manufacturing operations for cosmetics and personal hygiene products such as creams, lotions, body washes and other formulations. The role entails ownership of production, quality, regulatory compliance, engineering, EHS, and workforce management, aligned with both Egyptian local regulations and international cosmetic GMP standards (e.g., ISO 22716, FDA, EU Cosmetics Regulation) Core Responsibilities: 1. Manufacturing Operations Drive daily production to meet planned volumes, efficiency, and quality KPIs. Ensure adherence to GMP, ISO 22716 (cosmetic GMP), and other hygiene-specific protocols. Quality, Hygiene & Regulatory Ensure zero-compromise hygiene standards in line with MOHP (Ministry of Health and Population), CAPMAS, and relevant EU/international regulations. Engineering & Maintenance Oversee preventive and predictive maintenance programs for high-speed filling, labeling, and packing lines. Ensure uninterrupted utility services (compressed air, chilled water, HVAC, clean rooms). Lead initiatives for automation, energy savings, and digital transformation. 4. Supply Chain Coordination Collaborate with Procurement, Planning, and Logistics for seamless RM/PM availability and dispatch planning. Monitor warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, and FIFO management. Ensure optimal coordination for exports/imports (customs, port handling). 5. Ensure equipment installation and validation is completed per regulatory and operational timelines.

review_candidates.title: Field Services Supervisor
review_candidates.description: Category Field Service Job Location Omaha, NE, US Position Type Full-Time/Regular The Field Service Supervisor oversees a team of field service technicians, providing leadership, guidance, and support to ensure efficient and effective delivery of on-site technical support, maintenance, and repair services to customers. This role involves coordinating service activities, optimizing resource allocation, and managing service performance to meet customer needs, service level agreements, and business objectives. Required Skills Supervise and mentor a team of field service technicians, providing direction, training, and support to enhance their technical skills, productivity, and customer service capabilities. Assign service tasks, schedule work assignments, and coordinate field service activities to ensure timely response to customer requests and optimal utilization of resources. Plan and organize field service operations, including scheduling service calls, dispatching technicians, and coordinating logistics to maximize efficiency and minimize downtime. Collaborate with internal departments, such as customer service, sales, and operations, to prioritize service requests, address customer concerns, and resolve service-related issues. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, acting as a primary point of contact for service inquiries, escalations, and technical support, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. Conduct regular site visits and customer meetings to assess service performance, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement or additional service offerings. Monitor and evaluate service performance metrics, such as response time, resolution time, first-time fix rate, and customer satisfaction scores, and take corrective actions as needed to meet service level targets. Prepare and analyze service reports, dashboards, and KPIs, providing insights and recommendations to management for improving service quality and operational efficiency. Coordinate training programs and technical workshops for field service technicians to enhance their skills, knowledge, and proficiency in servicing equipment, troubleshooting issues, and delivering exceptional customer service. Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices in field service management, sharing insights and updates with the team to drive continuous improvement. Required Experience Strong leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team of technicians, foster a collaborative work environment, and drive performance and accountability. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders, and communicate technical information clearly and concisely. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, handle high-pressure situations, and make timely decisions to meet customer needs and service commitments. Analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to analyze data, identify trends, and implement strategies to improve service delivery and customer satisfaction. Knowledge of field service management principles, processes, and best practices, as well as familiarity with relevant regulations, safety standards, and industry guidelines.
